storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Twitter X Downloader makes it easy to save videos, images, and post text from X (Twitter) to your computer.

How it works: Go to any page on X.com (Twitter), click the extension icon, and the popup shows all detected media. Switch between Videos, Images, and Text tabs to browse. Download individually or click "Download Visible" to grab everything at once.

The extension detects video streams from multiple sources — DOM elements, inline page data, network requests, and the X API — so it catches media that other tools miss. Videos save as standard MP4 files. Images save as JPG or PNG. Post text saves as TXT.

Key features:
- Automatic video detection from multiple sources (DOM, inline scripts, Performance API, X API)
- Downloads videos, images, and post text from any X (Twitter) page
- Tabbed popup with Videos / Images / Text tabs and stats
- Bulk download all visible items with one click
- Inline overlay buttons on videos and images for quick downloads
- X API video resolution with guest token authentication
- Declarative Net Request header rules for reliable media fetching
- Saves videos as MP4, images as JPG/PNG, text as TXT
- Smart deduplication and scoring to surface the best quality
- Dark UI matching the X (Twitter) design language
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to X.com (Twitter) and browse any page
3. Click the extension icon to scan the page
4. Switch tabs, pick items, and download — or hit "Download Visible"

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from X (Twitter)?
faq.answer: Go to any X page, click the extension icon, and switch to the Videos tab. Click Download on the video you want, or use Download Visible to get them all.

faq.question: Can I download images too?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects images from X posts. Switch to the Images tab in the popup to see and download them.

faq.question: What about post text?
faq.answer: Yes. Switch to the Text tab to see extracted post content. Download saves it as a TXT file.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available quality variants from X's video API. It scores and ranks by bitrate, preferring MP4 over HLS manifests, and downloads the best available quality.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Media saves to a Twitter X Downloader subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory, organized by source and title.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Scroll the post into view so the video loads. Then click Rescan. The extension needs the media to be present in the page DOM or network activity.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All processing happens locally in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
